title: Reference caption example
description: Shape of one report's captions.he.json file in the Hebrew industrial-photo captioning reference dataset.

original_text_he.description: Exact original Hebrew wording for the whole group, verbatim from the source DOCX. Immutable - never written to by the review screen. Editing happens only on each source_blocks entry's own approved_text_he.

legacy_unmapped_images.description: Filenames selected under an earlier, group-level-only mapping model, before source_blocks existed. Kept so no prior work is lost; never redistributed automatically - a human must re-assign each one to the correct block.

legacy_group_review.description: Historical record of the group-level review workflow used before per-block approval existed (reviewed_at/reviewer_name/audit_log). Read-only, kept for audit purposes only.

source_blocks.description: Read-only-labeled, per-photo-number review units. Each maps its own text and images independently of the others.

document_photo_refs.description: The document's own photo numbers this block covers, e.g. ['1.1','1.2','1.3']. Never the same thing as an image instance's source_file - kept as separate concepts.

original_text_he.description: Exact source wording for this block. Immutable - never edited by the review screen.

approved_text_he.description: Editable, human-reviewed wording for this block. Starts identical to original_text_he.

image_instances.description: The images that back this block, in display order. The SAME source_file may appear in several instances (in this block, or in other blocks) - a source photo is not exclusive to one block. A 'crop' instance never modifies the original file; it stores only a normalized rectangle interpreted at render time.

source_file.description: Filename under this report's images/ folder. Never modified by crop/instance operations.

crop.description: Normalized (0.0-1.0) crop rectangle relative to the orientation-corrected source image. Null for variant_type 'full'.

preview_path.description: Optional locally generated cache path for a pre-rendered preview. Never the source image itself, and never required - the UI can always re-render from source_file + crop.

extraction_confidence.description: human_annotated: a reviewer already split this block by hand. numbers_confirmed_text_unsplit: document_photo_refs verified against the DOCX/layout PDF, but the text has not been split per number yet. uncertain: no reliable number evidence found.

ambiguity_notes.description: Free text explaining any uncertainty in this block's number-to-text mapping. Empty when there is none.

layout_evidence.description: Which layout PDF and 1-indexed page number visually confirms this block's photo numbers, or null if not determinable.

cannot_determine_reason.description: Structured reason recorded when status is 'cannot_determine'. Null otherwise, and cleared automatically the moment an image is assigned again.
